.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r3/task/tests/** (all judge.toml/prompt.md/app_context.md/scoring.toml, scanned for verbatim n-gram overlap with /instructions)
evidence: Skill procedure (quality-checks.md:70-71): '/app holds nothing but .gitkeep; no starter, skeleton, schema, route list, or partial UI anywhere in the agent image; nothing under /instructions/ reproduces criterion text or the rubric.' (1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-for-byte identical in content to the template Dockerfile (both 26 lines). It copies only instructions/ -> /instructions/ (line 14) and assets/ -> /assets/ (line 15); /app receives only an empty .gitkeep committed in a fresh git repo (lines 17-23). Build context task/environment/ contains exactly Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md (ls -la; no hidden files, no .dockerignore needed). No COPY of solution/ or tests/; base image node:22-bookworm-slim plus global express@5.1.0/better-sqlite3@12.4.1 carry no task content. (2) /assets/seed_data.json: top-level keys are only generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users(10), jobs(3), applications(16), messages(127), notes(3), reads(6) - pure starting records; no expected outputs, no SQL schema/DDL, no routes, no code. Keyword scan: expected/criterion/rubric/judge/score/solution/golden/verdict = 0; 'answer'/'pass' hits are only seed prose ('Strong systems answers...', 'I have passed your notes...'). It is identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is input data the golden copies, not a deliverable. (3) /instructions: hireops_rules.md is a behavioural rule note that explicitly leaves 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages' to the agent (line 3-5); it states HTTP status semantics (401/403/404/409) as behaviour, not a route list or schema. integration.md is the template integration note plus a 5-line symlink/delivery paragraph (lines 16-19); it says 'How routes and files are laid out under /app is up to you.' Scan of both notes for grader vocabulary (criterion, rubric, judge, grader, score, verifier, sentinel, CHANGE_ME, TODO, test.sh): 0 hits. Longest verbatim token overlap between /instructions and any tests/ file is 10 tokens ('arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order') in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:209 - the criterion quoting the public rule hireops_rules.md:90, not the environment reproducing criterion text; no criterion ids, fixture names (A2, V, Y, W, X) or pass/fail conditions appear in /instructions. Adversarial consideration: a broken app cannot pass by copying something from the image because there is no partial UI/server to copy; a conforming alternative is not pushed toward a particular structure because no skeleton, schema or route list is supplied. Limitation: I did not build or inspect the actual image (no Docker per assignment); conclusion rests on the Dockerfile and its full build context, which fully determine the task-specific layers.
